description: AI trading journal: MT5 sync, MCP tools for Claude, web UI

tool_signatures.name: annotate_trade
tool_signatures.description: Add journal details (setup, emotions, mistakes, notes, rating) to a trade, usually one synced from MT5.

trade.description: Trade id, or "last" for the most recent trade (optionally narrowed by symbol/date)

on_date.description: Narrow 'last' to trades closed on this date

emotions.description: Added to existing emotions unless replace_tags is true

mistakes.description: Added to existing mistakes unless replace_tags is true

notes.description: Appended to existing notes unless replace_notes is true

parameters.name: emotions
parameters.description: Added to existing emotions unless replace_tags is true

parameters.name: mistakes
parameters.description: Added to existing mistakes unless replace_tags is true

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Appended to existing notes unless replace_notes is true

parameters.name: on_date
parameters.description: Narrow 'last' to trades closed on this date

parameters.name: trade
parameters.description: Trade id, or "last" for the most recent trade (optionally narrowed by symbol/date)

tool_signatures.name: delete_trade
tool_signatures.description: Delete a manually logged trade (MT5 trades can't be deleted; they come back on sync).

tool_signatures.name: find_trades
tool_signatures.description: Search trades. Returns a compact list plus the total count.

sort.description: time, net_pnl, r_multiple, volume, holding; prefix - for descending

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: time, net_pnl, r_multiple, volume, holding; prefix - for descending

tool_signatures.name: get_behavior_report
tool_signatures.description: Behavioural red flags (revenge trading, overtrading, no/widened stops, early exits, sizing up after losses...) with cost.

tool_signatures.name: get_calendar
tool_signatures.description: Daily P&L for a month (trading days only), weekly totals and the month summary.

month.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

tool_signatures.name: get_coaching_context
tool_signatures.description: Everything needed for a coaching review in one call: stats vs previous period, per-instrument verdicts and

tool_signatures.name: get_instrument_breakdown
tool_signatures.description: Per-instrument stats, verdict (edge/leaking/breakeven/unproven), best/worst sessions, insights and red flags.

tool_signatures.name: get_performance
tool_signatures.description: Win rate, P&L, profit factor, expectancy, R, drawdown, streaks — optionally broken down by dimension.

tool_signatures.name: get_trade
tool_signatures.description: Full detail of one trade: prices, costs, R, MFE/MAE, deals, journal, and any behaviour flags it triggered.

tool_signatures.name: list_tags
tool_signatures.description: The user's setup, emotion and mistake vocabularies. Reuse these names when tagging.

tool_signatures.name: log_trade
tool_signatures.description: Log a trade the user dictates that is NOT in MT5 (other broker, or not synced). Returns the trade and warnings.

exit_price.description: Leave empty if the trade is still open

pnl.description: Money result before commission, if the user said it

parameters.name: close_time
parameters.description: ISO datetime (local time)

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: long/buy or short/sell

parameters.name: exit_price
parameters.description: Leave empty if the trade is still open

parameters.name: open_time
parameters.description: ISO datetime, e.g. 2026-10-26T09:30 (local time)

parameters.name: pnl
parameters.description: Money result before commission, if the user said it

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Execution quality 1-5

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Instrument, e.g. EURUSD

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Lots

tool_signatures.name: save_ai_report
tool_signatures.description: Save a coaching review so it shows in the web app (AI Coach page and each instrument's page).

tool_signatures.name: save_trade_feedback
tool_signatures.description: Attach AI feedback to a single trade (shown on the trade's page).

parameters.name: feedback
parameters.description: Coaching feedback on this trade

tool_signatures.name: set_trading_rules
tool_signatures.description: Save the user's written trading rules; coaching reviews check behaviour against them.

rules.description: The user's full trading plan/rules as text

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: The user's full trading plan/rules as text

tool_signatures.name: sync_mt5
tool_signatures.description: Pull the latest trades from MT5 right now.

force.description: Re-read every file and rebuild all trades

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Re-read every file and rebuild all trades

tool_signatures.name: write_day_note
tool_signatures.description: Save the pre-session plan or post-session review for a day (text is appended to what is there).

mood.description: One word, e.g. focused, tired, anxious

parameters.description: Defaults to today

parameters.name: mood
parameters.description: One word, e.g. focused, tired, anxious
